surfaces.label: Request Transport
exit_criteria: final URL, method, body, and initiator are captured
transport rewrites are separated from signer logic

surfaces.label: Header Mutation
exit_criteria: header write order and value provenance are recorded
missing replay headers are parameterized until verified

surfaces.label: Cookie State
exit_criteria: cookie read/write order is captured
accepted cookie shape is tied to a runtime request

surfaces.label: Storage State
exit_criteria: seed key and read/write timing are known
storage-derived request fields are labeled

surfaces.label: Crypto Helper
exit_criteria: candidate inputs and outputs are listed
patched helpers are not treated as standard library truth

surfaces.label: WASM or Worker Boundary
exit_criteria: module or worker boundary artifact is preserved
runtime input/output samples are available before local rebuild

surfaces.label: Async Channel
exit_criteria: channel payload direction and timing are recorded
request contract distinguishes pushed state from local signer output

surfaces.label: Dynamic Script
exit_criteria: inserted script URL and callback are captured
script-loaded state is separated from API request state

surfaces.label: Initiator Call Frame
exit_criteria: caller frame or helper target is known
trace target is narrow enough for priority capture

surfaces.label: Timing or Fingerprint
exit_criteria: time source and fingerprint dependency are recorded
anti-detection profile changes are separated from replay correctness
